# `producers/maintenance.ts`

## Overview

The `maintenance` module scans a repository for technical debt signals — including legacy patterns, outdated dependencies, overgrown functions, duplicated code, dead code, and stale type definitions — and creates prioritised maintenance tasks. It exposes a `MaintenanceProducer` class and a ready-to-use singleton instance (`maintenanceProducer`).

---

## Interfaces

### `MaintenanceScores`

Represents the scoring dimensions used to evaluate a maintenance finding.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` | The value score of the finding |
| `complexity` | `number` | The complexity score of the finding |
| `risk` | `number` | The risk score of the finding |
| `block` | `number` | The blocking score of the finding |

---

### `MaintenanceFinding`

Represents a single maintenance finding produced by the LLM analysis.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | Short title describing the finding |
| `body` | `string` | Detailed description of the finding |
| `category` | `string` | Category the finding belongs to |
| `scores` | `MaintenanceScores` | Scoring dimensions for the finding |
| `priority` | `number` | Priority rank assigned to the finding |

### `complexityToSize(complexity)`

Maps a numeric complexity value to a size string.

```ts
complexityToSize(complexity: number): string
```

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `complexity` | `number` | The numeric complexity score to convert |

**Returns:** `string` — A string representation of the size corresponding to the given complexity.

---

### `parseFindings(text)`

Attempts to parse an LLM response as a JSON array of `MaintenanceFinding` objects. Returns an empty array if parsing fails or the result is not an array.

```ts
parseFindings(text: string): MaintenanceFinding[]
```

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | Raw text response from the LLM to parse |

**Returns:** `MaintenanceFinding[]` — An array of parsed findings, or an empty array if parsing fails.

**Example:**

```ts
const findings = parseFindings(llmResponse)

if (findings.length === 0) {
  console.warn('No valid findings could be parsed from the LLM response.')
}
```
